description: Cache Rules (§1): anonymous public pages on joutiya.ma are cached for the TTL the origin sends (ISR s-maxage); a production deploy purges the cache. Only locale-prefixed paths: '/' and unprefixed paths redirect per visitor. Bypassed as soon as the __Host-session cookie is present. Private pages send no-store. Build assets (/_next/static) are cached by default.

rules.description: Anonymous public pages: cache, TTLs from the origin
rules.expression: http.host eq "joutiya.ma" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/fr" "/ar" "/rif"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fr/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ar/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rif/")) and not http.cookie contains "__Host-session"
